关键词: Unaudited Interim Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements
主要内容: The document titled '6-K' is a report filed by the Royal Bank of Canada with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). It is part of the Form 6-K filing, which is used by foreign private issuers to report information to the SEC. The report includes the First Quarter 2014 Earnings Release, the Report to Shareholders, which contains management's discussion and analysis and unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements, and an Industry Guide on Return on Equity and Assets Ratios. The filing is incorporated by reference into several Registration Statements on Form F-3 and S-8. The report was signed by Janice R. Fukakusa, the Chief Administrative Officer and Chief Financial Officer of the Royal Bank of Canada, on February 26, 2014.
